subject: SkylineHealth renewal: capacity uplift, term amendment & QBR scheduling
snippet: Agreeing timeline for capacity uplift, proposed term amendment, and locking QBR date; internal owners for pricing and SRE noted.
messages:
From: John Li <jli@skylinehealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@skylinehealth.com>, procurement@skylinehealth.com
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal planning — capacity uplift & term questions

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you and the Redwood team are well. We're coming up on our January renewal window and want to discuss a few items ahead of time:

- We expect a 2.5x increase in inference volume for patient triage models starting Feb–Mar 2027.
- We'd like to extend the current 12‑month term to 24 months in exchange for a committed capacity tier and a units-based discount.
- Procurement will need an updated SOW and a simple timeline to review for legal and budget approval.

Can we lock a QBR slot in mid‑December to align execs and SREs, or do you recommend waiting until early January? Alicia from Ops is copied — she can share specific volume projections.

Thanks,
John
Director, ML Infra
SkylineHealth

[Attachment: forecast_summary_dec2026.csv (CSV, 45 KB)]

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: John Li <jli@skylinehealth.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift & term questions

John — thanks for the context and the forecast. Short answer: we can support the uplift and I suggest the following approach so procurement/legal have the artifacts they need before the renewal window.

Proposed next steps & timeline
- This week (Dec 7–10): internal sizing + pricing sketch from our sales ops and infra team.
- Dec 13–17: QBR to review forecast, proposed SOW (draft), and handoff to procurement. Midpoints: Dec 14 or Dec 15 at 10am PT (please confirm).
- Dec 20: Redwood delivers a redline‑ready SOW and term amendment with committed capacity tiers and a delta pricing appendix.
- Jan 5–12: Procure/Legal review; sign by Jan 31 to meet Feb capacity start.

Owners I’m looping in here: Marissa (commercial terms & SOW), Ben (capacity/SRE sizing).

A few clarifying questions for Alicia to help the sizing:
1) Can you attach a daily percentile distribution (p50/p95) for inference token rates?
2) Any hard latency SLOs that must be preserved with the uplift?
3) Do you want a single committed pool or staged burst lanes (cheaper committed + burst credits)?

I’ll put a calendar invite for Dec 14 10am PT and attach a draft SOW template for review.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOW_template_redwood_v1.docx (DOCX, 120 KB)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: John Li <jli@skylinehealth.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift & term questions

Kim / Ben — quick internal note before the QBR:
- Pricing: I'll prepare two options — (A) 24‑month term with 15% discount on hosted token rates + committed GPU pool, (B) 12‑month term with stepped uplifts and a smaller initial commit. Option A assumes a 12‑month smoothing of p50 base and p95 burst capacity.
- SOW: I will prefill the SOW with the baseline throughput, rollout milestones (data onboarding -> canary -> full traffic), and a rollback/fallback clause referencing model variant fallbacks.
- Legal: Procurement will ask for data retention, KMS controls, and SOC 2 evidence — include the standard link to our compliance pack.

Ben — can your sizing run two scenarios: \"steady 2.5x\" and \"spikey peak + 4x short bursts\" with recommended autoscale cushion? I’ll sync commercial numbers to both.

Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: John Li <jli@skylinehealth.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity uplift & term questions

Quick update after sizing run and the QBR today:

- Sizing notes: 2.5x steady state maps to an additional 8 A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale headroom of ~30% to absorb p95 spikes. Spikey scenario requires temporary burst lanes (recommend pre-warmed burst pool of 4 q4 GPUs).
- Drafts attached: updated SOW (Skyline_SOW_v2.pdf) and capacity estimate spreadsheet. I included the staging schedule so Infra can validate the canary window and rollback steps.
- Action items:
  1) Kimberly: send the SOW and pricing option A/B to procurement for review (target Dec 21).
  2) Marissa: finalize discount language and the committed capacity appendix (target Dec 21).
  3) John / Alicia: please confirm latency SLOs and the p95 tail you want guaranteed during peak windows.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect — Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: Skyline_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB); capacity-estimate-2027.xlsx (XLSX, 350 KB)]
